title: BCI Competition 2020 Track 5 — ERP during walking (scalp, ear-EEG, and IMU)
description: EEG recordings from 15 healthy participants performing a visual P300 oddball task while walking on a treadmill at 1.6 m/s. The dataset combines 46-channel scalp EEG, 14-channel ear-EEG, EOG, and 6-channel inertial measurement unit signals. It was released for BCI Competition 2020 Track 5 to evaluate brain-computer interface performance under ambulatory conditions, with trials split temporally into training, validation, and test sets.
methods_description: Participants viewed target ('OOO') and non-target ('XXX') visual stimuli (target ratio 0.2) while walking on a treadmill at 1.6 m/s. Data were recorded from 46 scalp EEG channels (10-20 montage), 14 ear-EEG channels (7 per ear), 4 EOG channels, and 6 IMU channels (3-axis accelerometer and gyroscope) at 100 Hz. Epochs span -190 ms to +800 ms around stimulus onset.
